Game Overview

In Skull Jump, the core idea is straightforward: leap through perilous terrains in Skull Jump, where your agility is your only shield against looming dangers. Tap once, twice, or thrice to defy gravity and dodge deadly threats. React swiftly to stay alive and keep the game going in this thrilling test of reflexes and timing.
